timingMeaning: Exclusive CPU-side render-state extraction and submission intervals, with separate sources. Calls count both stages. Deferred feature execution and GPU work are outside these per-object intervals.
coverageMeaning: Real-world entities and block entities reached through vanilla extraction/submission dispatchers. Registry and renderer implementation ownership are separate. Preview entities and virtual block worlds are excluded. Shader shadow calls are excluded when the optional public Iris API identifies them; shaderCoverage records API availability/failures. Terrain, particles, items and GUI are not attributed.
geometryMeaning: Unavailable: later deferred feature batches are not assigned to objects. Zero geometry fields do not assert that an object generated no geometry.
gpuMeaning: Unavailable in this render-state adapter. CPU intervals are not GPU timings, VRAM or predicted FPS gains.
percentiles: Capture histograms are bounded; averages include frames with zero calls.
